text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ? Ahh... I've done it again, sir...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Lately, it seems I've been unconsciously 
tensing up my face... And everyone has 
been even more frightened of me than 
usual...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to consecutive races, it seems 
she's having trouble switching between on 
and off mode, sir...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have accumulated far more 
fatigue than expected. I need to urgently 
reconsider her schedule...
